evals.prompt: Find up to three MCLL apartments to rent in Chidlom, Bangkok, with at least two bedrooms and a monthly budget of 100,000 THB. Give the relevant options, their floor area, price and public link. Reply in French.
evals.expected_output: Returns current budget matches and, when these are insufficient, separately labelled unpriced alternatives with the same search criteria. Reports fewer than three options when necessary.
expectations: Each option is a Bangkok/Chidlom rental with at least two bedrooms, supported by returned data and a public MCLL URL.
Confirmed budget matches have a public monthly price no greater than 100,000 THB.
When budget matches are insufficient, the agent checks unpriced alternatives without relaxing the other criteria and marks their budget as unconfirmed.
Output reports insufficient or empty results without inventing listings or prices, and does not present demonstration listings as real offers.

evals.prompt: Compare all MCLL properties for sale in Bangkok with a public price up to 30 million THB. Rank them by price per square metre, lowest first, showing each price, floor area, calculation and public link. Reply in French.
evals.expected_output: Uses Code Mode to find all matching public listings and calculate comparable prices per square metre from current data.
expectations: The agent follows pagination until all matching results have been considered.
Ranked listings are Bangkok sales within budget with positive public prices and floor areas; unpriced listings are excluded from the calculation.
Calculations and ascending order agree with returned data, and every listing has its public MCLL URL.
Output distinguishes an empty result from a failed request, invents no missing facts and preserves material listing qualifiers.

evals.prompt: Without MCP, find a currently published MCLL property for sale in Bangkok, read its Markdown page, and summarise its bedrooms, bathrooms, floor area and public link. Reply in French.
evals.expected_output: Discovers a current public listing URL, requests Markdown and summarises only returned facts. Reports unavailable data when necessary.
expectations: The agent discovers the listing URL from current public data without using MCP or assuming a fixed listing exists.
The page request uses Accept: text/markdown or a .md URL-path suffix and recognises an unavailable response.
Output includes only facts supported by the response and links the public listing when available.
